identity.short_identity: Frontend-heavy product engineer and AI builder specializing in React/Next.js, full-stack product development, and real-world LLM workflows.

summary.one_liner: Frontend-heavy product engineer and AI builder who has shipped real LLM-powered systems in healthtech, marketing, and developer tools.
summary.short_bio: Ganesh Shinde is a software engineer based in Bengaluru, India. He is frontend-heavy but not frontend-only: his main strength is turning product ideas into polished, usable systems, while increasingly owning backend flows, AI workflows, and end-to-end execution. He works primarily with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web stacks, and has hands-on experience building AI products using LLMs, prompt pipelines, structured JSON outputs, document analysis workflows, and Vertex AI / Gemini-based systems. He has worked in startup environments, shipped user-facing products, and contributed across product, frontend, backend workflows, QA, AI integration, and developer tooling.
summary.work_style: Execution-focused, product-minded, comfortable in messy startup environments, prefers high ownership and direct feedback over safe corporate paths.

family.notes: Father and one brother work in business; Ganesh chose an engineering and product-building path.

goals.primary_career_goal: Join a strong AI startup (preferably US-based or YC-backed) as an early / product engineer and build real AI systems end-to-end.
secondary_goals: Grow into a high-agency AI product / founding engineer.
Deepen backend, AI systems, and infra skills while keeping strong product and UX sense.
Avoid generic, low-ownership roles and optimize for learning, impact, and responsibility.
goals.long_term_direction: High-agency AI product engineering and startup building.

Built features that let users select repositories and scan types and automatically generate and inject CI/CD pipeline YAML into repositories.
Went beyond frontend by learning backend flows, SCM integrations, and CI/CD execution pipelines to deliver end-to-end functionality.
Identified a limitation in GitLab CI/CD where a single script cannot run across different runner environments (Linux/Windows) and designed dynamic OS-based pipeline generation.
Actively debugged and resolved production issues, improving stability and user experience.
Increased frontend test coverage from ~21.7% to ~90.4% by writing extensive test cases.
Contributed to internal developer tooling such as Bridge CLI and learned broader system architecture.
Built and scaled an AI-powered health analysis platform from 0→1 as a founding engineer.
Designed and implemented LLM-based systems (Gemini + Vertex AI) to convert unstructured health data into structured JSON insights.
Built two major AI systems: health report analysis and monthly health insights from user logs and activity.
Engineered multi-step prompt pipelines to handle large inputs and generate large structured outputs.
Developed an automated reporting system converting AI outputs into structured PDF reports, reducing manual report time from 2–5 days to under 30 seconds.
Implemented HIPAA-aware architecture using Vertex AI to handle sensitive healthcare data securely.
Led R&D on LLM reliability, prompt design, and real-world AI system behavior.
Built and optimized the Bewell mobile app (Flutter) and admin panel (React), reducing app size from ~35MB to ~14.6MB.
Built the Bewell mobile app from scratch and launched beta on Play Store and App Store.
Integrated AI-powered features using Gemini for personalized health insights.
Developed a React-based admin panel for handling large datasets and workflows.
Improved app performance, UX, and scalability.
Reduced app size from ~35MB to ~14.6MB, significantly improving distribution and performance.
Built and enhanced a Flutter + Bloc mobile app frontend with appointment booking, payments, and expert showcase features.
Improved app performance and maintainability through better state management and architecture.
Helped build a school management desktop app using React, Tailwind, Electron, and Firebase.
Contributed to a mobile app for students and a location tracking app for school buses.
Mentored frontend developers on React, JavaScript, and CSS.
Guided teams on component architecture, state management, and responsive design.
Led development of multiple web projects from concept to deployment using React, Next.js, Tailwind, Node.js, MongoDB, MySQL, and PHP.
Worked on animation-heavy frontends using GSAP and handled deployments.
Collaborated with Nokia professionals on a project that placed 3rd among ~20 college projects.
Demonstrated teamwork, algorithmic thinking, and remote collaboration.
Contributed to an admin panel frontend using React and Tailwind, and backend with MySQL.
Worked on a Flutter mobile app using Dart and Firebase for real-time data.

projects.name: HealthAI
projects.description: AI-powered health analysis platform that uses Vertex AI / Gemini to convert unstructured health data into structured insights and reports.
key_capabilities: Multi-format file upload (PDF, DOCX, Excel, CSV, TXT).
Biomarker analysis with clinical vs optimal ranges.
Four pillars scoring (Eat, Sleep, Move, Recover).
Monthly health reports with trend analysis and radar charts.
Interactive JSON outputs and prompt-testing interfaces.
projects.why_it_matters: Shows ability to build a vertical AI product, handle unstructured data, design prompt workflows, generate structured JSON, and ship a real deployed system.

Multi-step AI pipeline: product understanding → marketing strategy → content generation.
Generates ICP, positioning, pain points, messaging angles.
Outputs ad copy, email sequences, landing page structure, CTAs.
Exports to PDF, JSON, Markdown, CSV, and social content templates.
projects.why_it_matters: Demonstrates multi-step LLM workflows, strong product sense, real founder users, and case-study level validation.

qa_guidelines.tone: Confident, clear, and factual. Not arrogant, not self-deprecating. Startup/engineering-minded.
when_answering_about_experience: Do not exaggerate seniority. Ganesh is early-career but with strong startup exposure.
Emphasize Bewell, Black Duck, HealthAI, and Stratifai as the strongest proof.
Mention deployed, real systems rather than only tutorials or toy projects.
when_answering_about_roles: Say Ganesh is best aligned with AI startup product engineer / early engineer roles rather than only 'frontend developer'.
Mention he wants to work closely with founders, own features end-to-end, and build real AI systems.
when_answering_about_goals: State clearly that Ganesh wants to join a high-quality AI startup (US/YC-like) and grow into a high-agency AI product / founding engineer.
